LanguageData.SSC_MasterBondEmpowerment.description: A libidinal field formed by the coupling of purple nanomachine resonance and psychic force. As more slaves are bound and their corruption deepens, the field steadily strengthens the master's body, battle instinct, and power of domination.

LanguageData.Hediff_PNA_Combat_Buff.description: Under purple nanomachine aphrodisiac stimulation, a sex slave's cells become active and agitated, increasing combat capability.

LanguageData.Hediff_PNA_Debuff.label: Nano-Aphrodisiac Corrosion
LanguageData.Hediff_PNA_Debuff.description: Purple aphrodisiac nanofluid is stimulating nerves throughout the body. Desire is harder to suppress and pain grows dull. As its effects deepen, movement and attention slip out of control, and sights and sounds appear where nothing exists. At its peak, the body undergoes involuntary, repeated orgasms until consciousness gives way.

LanguageData.SSC_PostExcretionComa.description: After forced personality extraction, the brain and nervous system enter severe restructuring and blanking; the initial personality is taking control.

LanguageData.SSC_PostInsertionComa.description: After forced insertion of an external personality into a hollow body, the brain and nervous system need time to adapt and recover.
